# DSH Share
DSH Share is a macOS sharing tool that sends files, images, text and links from other apps on the **
same Mac** to the **DeepSeek Harness desktop app** through the system Share menu. Shares appear as a
ttachments in the **current thread’s input area**. Review them and send manually when ready.
English | 简体中文
## Features

- **Finder:** select one or more regular files, then choose **Share → DeepSeek Harness**.
- **WeChat
for Mac:** use **Other apps → Choose an app on this computer → DeepSeek Harness** when the content

offers that option.
- Files, images, plain text and URLs exposed through a compatible macOS Share me
nu are accepted. Each share is limited to **128 files and 256 MiB in total**; folders are not suppor

ted.
- If DeepSeek Harness is not running, DSH Share attempts to open it. If opening fails, an error

is reported to the user. Shared content remains queued locally until the app and plugin start.
- Af
ter confirmed forwarding, DSH Share immediately removes its local copies and forwarding records.
DSH Share provides a Universal 2 DMG containing Apple Silicon and Intel binaries — download the late
st release. Its setup assistant connects to Harness desktop automatically. Installation and everyday
use require neither Python nor a standalone Node.js runtime. Source installation is also available;
see compatibility for supported environments and verification limits.
## Download
Two installation paths are supported, and you only need one:
- **Option A — prebuilt DMG, for general users**: latest release — `DSHShare-<version>-universal2.dm

g` plus its `.sha256`.
- **Option B — build from source, for professional developers**: clone this r
epository and follow Option B.
Changes between versions: CHANGELOG.md.
## Before installing
You need:
- macOS **13 or newer**. Testing so far used an **Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 27.0.1**; Intel Ma

cs and other OS versions are not yet verified.
- A working DeepSeek Harness desktop installation. Th
e plugin interfaces were tested with **0.2.1-rc.5**.
Whichever path you pick, the result is the same two pieces: the native Share target (**DSHShare.app*
*) and the DeepSeek Harness plugin (**dsh-macos-share**). You never install both paths.
The inbox lock, cleanup command and plugin profile installer use a native executable bundled inside
**DSHShare.app**. Installation and everyday use do not require Python or a separately installed Node
.js runtime. The compiler is needed for source installation; the installed app uses macOS-provided r
compiler is needed for source installation; the installed app uses macOS-provided runtime libraries.
### System permissions
DSH Share needs **two actions from you** and **three entitlements that macOS grants at install time
without a prompt**. Nothing else is requested — no Full Disk Access, no Files & Folders, no Accessib
ility, Screen Recording, Automation, Notifications, Camera or Microphone.
| What you will be asked | Why it is needed | What breaks without it |
| **Open Anyway** under **Privacy & Security** (first launch only) | The DMG build is ad-hoc signed
and not notarized by Apple, so Gatekeeper blocks its first launch. | The setup assistant cannot star

t, so the app, helper and Share extension are never installed. |
| **General → Login Items & Extensi
ons → Sharing → DeepSeek Harness** | macOS ships third-party Share extensions **disabled**; the entr
y is listed but inert until you enable it. | The system Share menu has no **DeepSeek Harness** item,

so nothing can be shared. The assistant re-checks this step and tells you what to click. |
| **A ru
nning, configured DeepSeek Harness** (no OS prompt) | The plugin that receives shares runs inside Ha
rness, not in the appex. | Shares stay queued in the local inbox until Harness and the plugin are ru
nning; the setup assistant otherwise reports it. |
Sandbox entitlements — declared in the code signature, granted at install, **no dialog ever appears*

| Entitlement | Why it exists |
| `com.apple.security.app-sandbox` | macOS refuses to load a Share extension that is not sandboxed,

so this one is mandatory for the entry to work at all. It grants no data access by itself. |

## Privacy and local data
Sharing puts attachments in the current Harness draft. The agent starts only after you send the draf
t. Model access, network transmission and tool permissions follow **your DeepSeek Harness configurat
ion**; only share content you intend that agent to process.
The native extension hands content over through a local directory and does not need model API keys.
This project adds no independent telemetry or analytics service.
| Location | Purpose |
| `/Applications/DSHShare.app` or `~/Applications/DSHShare.app` | Share menu target and setup assist

ant |
| `~/Library/Application Support/DSHShare/plugins/dsh-macos-share` | Plugin files installed by

the default installer |
| `~/Library/Application Support/DSHShare/inbox` | Pending local copies of

shares |
| `inbox/failed/` | Failed packages and their error details |
DSH Share does not keep a session history or an archive of completed shares. Once the Harness input
area owns the attachments and confirms receipt, DSH Share immediately deletes the inbox copy, delive
ry state and temporary completion receipt. The session and attachments received by DeepSeek Harness
are the forwarding result and are managed by Harness itself.
Interrupted cleanup resumes automatically when the receiver runs again. Confirmed completion records
left by earlier versions are also removed, without an age limit. Failed packages remain available f
or diagnosis; do not publish inbox contents or logs containing shared data.
**Pending, unconfirmed and failed content never expires automatically.** Files are transferred throu
gh a bounded local stream into Harness-owned browser attachments. Text and links are attached as a U
TF-8 text file. Draft attachments follow Harness’s own lifecycle; closing or reloading Harness may d
iscard an unsent draft. DeepSeek Harness may impose additional attachment limits.
